checkedAlternates.risk: Tied-arch bridges hang the deck from vertical hangers/cables.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A tied-arch’s primary load-bearing member is the rigid compression arch (group-3), rather than towers and main tension cables (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Extradosed bridges have stiffer girder decks like box-girders.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Extradosed bridges are hybrid cable-stayed structures (group-4).
